panels.title: Источники данных — объём и свежесть (age_hours: зелёный <24ч, жёлтый <48ч, красный >48ч)

targets.rawSql: SELECT source, records, last_update, round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - last_update))/3600, 1) AS age_hours FROM ( SELECT 'ЕГР: карточки компаний' AS source, count(*)::bigint AS records, max(updated_at) AS last_update FROM egr_companies UNION ALL SELECT 'ЕГР: raw (не обработано)', count(*) FILTER (WHERE processed_at IS NULL)::bigint, max(updated_at) FROM egr_raw_company_data UNION ALL SELECT 'ГРП: плательщики', count(unp)::bigint, max(fetched_at) FROM grp_taxpayer_data UNION ALL SELECT 'ЕГР Mobile: адреса', count(unp)::bigint, max(fetched_at) FROM egr_company_place_locations UNION ALL SELECT 'МАРТ: торговый реестр', count(id)::bigint, max(last_seen_at) FROM trade_registry_records UNION ALL SELECT 'Лицензии (license.gov.by)', count(id)::bigint, max(last_seen_at) FROM license_records UNION ALL SELECT 'ГИАС: аккред. заказчики', count(id)::bigint, max(last_seen_at) FROM gias_accredited_customers UNION ALL SELECT 'ГИАС: недобросов. поставщики', count(id)::bigint, max(last_seen_at) FROM locked_suppliers UNION ALL SELECT 'ПВТ: резиденты', count(id)::bigint, max(last_seen_at) FROM pvt_resident_records UNION ALL SELECT 'ЕАЭС: резиденты СЭЗ', count(id)::bigint, max(last_seen_at) FROM eaeu_sez_resident_records UNION ALL SELECT 'МНС: задолженности', count(id)::bigint, max(created_at) FROM nalog_debt_records UNION ALL SELECT 'Банкротство: дела', count(case_id)::bigint, max(updated_at) FROM bankrot_cases ) t ORDER BY age_hours DESC NULLS FIRST
